primary_retrieval_eval_rule: Use only support_status=supported. partial can be reported separately; exclude not_found and data_issue.

status_definitions.supported: The selected local textbook chunk(s) directly support the gold answer.
status_definitions.partial: The chunk(s) support only part of the answer or require a nontrivial derivation.
status_definitions.not_found: No adequate supporting chunk was identified in the local textbook corpus.
status_definitions.data_issue: The question record contains a material serialization/content defect and is excluded from primary evaluation.
